p: Alcester Road is the main road and high street through Kings Heath, a lively south Birmingham suburb a few miles out from the city centre. This Admiral sits on the parade of shops there, and it's an adult gaming centre: 18+ only.

Kings Heath has a strong reputation for independent places. You'll find bars, cafés, takeaways and restaurants all along the high street, and the Hare & Hounds is well known for live music. Kings Heath Park, a short walk away, has formal gardens and plenty of green space for a stroll. Lots of buses run up and down Alcester Road into Birmingham, so it's easy to pair a visit here with a trip into town or out towards Moseley next door.
